node: Sub-100nm barium titanate and dielectric powders for high-end MLCCs
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow US-accessible universe for the dielectric-powder node. The most node-proximate US-listed candidates are foreign ordinary OTC lines for Japanese chemical suppliers rather than US domestic issuers. Sakai Chemical and Nippon Chemical Industrial are the main underfollowed discovery candidates because their disclosed barium titanate / electronic ceramic material exposure sits upstream of AI-server MLCC makers. Murata is included only as a reference anchor because it is a dominant downstream MLCC producer and likely vertically integrated. Taiyo Yuden is included as a second-order downstream verifier / potential beneficiary, not as a confirmed powder supplier. Shandong Sinocera appears relevant but no US-listed line was verified in the gathered evidence, so it is excluded from candidates and retained as a coverage gap.
